title: Teardrop-shaped transmedium UAP video shown in a joint task force SCIF
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Teardrop-shaped transmedium UAP video shown in a joint task force SCIF, about unspecified at Over the ocean; joint task force overseas, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Over the ocean; joint task force overseas

tellings.quote: observing this teardropshaped looking UAP that might have been 20 ft lengthwise or so and it was traveling under the ocean water

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an email that a naval intelligence commander sent with a video attached. He says the video was shown inside a SCIF, a secure room for viewing classified material, at a military task force overseas, and that it showed a teardrop-shaped UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the government's term for a UFO, about 20 feet long and traveling under the ocean water. If true, it would mean unknown craft can move through the sea as well as the sky.
